desc:
This game includes Shift Lock for mobile players, PC, and console can play too.
Join our community server to meet fellow players, get a skill rank as seen in our group and much more!

Keybinds:
- Press "T" on PC or laptop to toggle the auto clicker. On mobile click the "AC" button to toggle.
- Type ;toggletitles to enable / disable the overhead title you earn from evaluations if you wish to not show it. Saves.

Tags: SFOTH, sword fighting, sword fights on the heights, mobile sword fight, mobile.
